· MACD histogram trajectory (0.6918→-1.2840) — worsening continues, entering bearish expansion after dead cross
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $159.87) — sideways near the middle band, band width at 17.87% indicates reduced volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($147.88) — based on Pivot S1 ($133.49) and 20-day low ($139.11)
· Swing resistance ($173.09) — approaching Pivot R1 ($175.87) and upper Bollinger Band ($174.16)
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern — sideways, no clear Higher Low or Lower High formation
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.38x) — contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis — sideways within accumulation zone, buy entry conditions not met due to MACD worsening and low volume, maintaining a wait-and-see approach
